### View editor
- Added a dedicated view editor with live HTML/CSS previews and an explicit Run JavaScript button. Open it from settings or the command palette.
- Preview notes matching a view's rules in main-note, page-preview, Canvas, and embedded-note contexts. Search for preview notes and edit rules using native Obsidian controls.
- Resize, reorder, hide, and dock code panels, or move them into a separate desktop window. Narrow layouts adapt to the available space, with touch-friendly controls.
- Create views from the view chooser with Shift+Enter, or Enter when the search has no matches.
- Keep edits synchronized across open editor tabs. Changes save automatically.

### Improvements
- Refreshed HTML, CSS, and JavaScript editor styling with Knap-inspired template and filter highlighting, using the user's font and theme colors.
- Added note-menu actions to edit a matching view, enable or disable it everywhere, or pause and show it for the current tab.
- Preserved preview scroll positions and runtime state during live edits, and reduced flicker when switching preview notes.

### Fixes
- Fixed live styles failing to update after a change was reverted.
- Fixed panel drags inserting header text when dropped onto editor content.
- Fixed shortcuts and native picker/Rules dismissal when interacting inside the preview.
- Fixed panel sizing, toolbar alignment, theme-specific bracket highlights, and preview cleanup on close.

### Validation
- 1,318 automated tests pass, plus local-deployment checks, lint, browser typechecking, and the production build.
- Verified desktop interactions and mobile layouts using Obsidian 1.14.1 desktop mobile emulation. Physical iOS/Android devices were not tested.
